objective: Independently determine whether the publisher-checksum-pinned CPVS g/r ZIP archives pass a second ZIP implementation's decompression and CRC validation before repeating the 100-object lineage scan.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #285 lineage run 43818485826 verified both downloaded archive SHA-256 values but failed while Python zipfile streamed the ztf2g member with BadZipFile: Bad CRC-32.
The failure does not establish whether the archive itself is malformed, Info-ZIP and Python disagree, or the failure is caused by a transfer/cache/runtime issue.
CPVS membership discrepancy #170 remains unresolved; no membership rule or threshold change is authorized.
Frozen scientific baseline v0.2.0 and 42-feature contract remain protected.

baseline.scope: Research-only workflow diagnostic; no scientific selection logic, source data, model, benchmark, feature schema, thresholds or production branch changes.

change.proposed: Add an independent Info-ZIP unzip -t integrity check and Python central-directory metadata report for the exact checksum-pinned Zenodo g/r archives.
change.scope: One research workflow and one cumulative lifecycle record. Upload compact diagnostic logs and metadata only; do not upload raw archive bytes.
change.rationale: A second independent decompressor is required to distinguish ZIP member corruption from Python zipfile-specific behavior before changing the lineage scanner.

expected_improvement: Independent CRC/decompression evidence for both pinned archives
Recorded archive SHA-256, byte size, member CRC, compressed size and uncompressed size
Fail-closed lineage execution: run the existing scanner only if the independent ZIP integrity checks pass

correctness.before: The 100-object lineage scan failed on ztf2g with a CRC error after archive SHA-256 checks passed.

reproducibility.before: Only the failed Python zipfile execution log was available.

measurement.trade_off: Independent archive integrity validation adds a gate before lineage analysis. It preserves the fail-closed rule and does not bypass CRC checks.

evidence: Workflow re-downloads the exact pinned Zenodo archives and checks their SHA-256 values.
Info-ZIP unzip -t provides an independent decompression and CRC validation implementation.
Python reads central-directory metadata without modifying source bytes.
Raw archive files are not uploaded as workflow artifacts.

The initial CI run 43856626824 failed before the archive workflow ran because this lifecycle record used unsupported knowledge_extraction and decision states. The record has been corrected; a new CI run is required.
validation.blocker: No independent Info-ZIP integrity result is available yet. Run the archive workflow and inspect its compact evidence artifact.

root_causes: The initial lifecycle gate failure was caused by knowledge_extraction.status=PENDING, an empty findings list, and decision=PENDING. The repository contract permits only defined knowledge statuses, requires non-empty findings, and accepts only ACCEPT, REVISE or BLOCKED.
unresolved: It is not yet known whether the pinned ztf2g ZIP member fails CRC under Info-ZIP or only under Python zipfile.
limitations: Successful ZIP integrity does not prove CPVS membership reconstruction.
Coordinate proximity is not proof of SourceID identity.
This diagnostic does not resolve the 11,602 candidate-only CPVS objects.

findings: A SHA-256 match verifies archive byte identity against the pinned digest. It does not verify decompression or the CRC of each ZIP member.
Do not bypass CRC validation or run lineage analysis after an independent archive-integrity failure.
Do not infer CPVS membership correctness from successful ZIP integrity.

open_blockers: Rerun CI and confirm the cumulative lifecycle gate passes on the corrected record.
Verify both ZIP archives with Info-ZIP.
If independent integrity passes, rerun the unchanged 100-object lineage scanner.
If it fails, preserve the failure and investigate publisher archive integrity without disabling CRC checks.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not alter CPVS membership rules or thresholds.
Do not close Issue #170 until the 11,602 discrepancy has a reproducible root cause.
Keep the original v0.2.0 baseline unchanged.
Treat the archive-integrity result and the CPVS membership result as separate claims.
